# MetalBiomeR

## Overview

MetalBiomeR is an R package for integrated analysis of heavy metal contamination and microbial communities, including 16S rRNA, ITS, and AMF datasets.

### Current Features

- Metal-microbe correlations
- Correlation heatmaps
- Metal-microbe networks
- Keystone taxa detection
- Metal tolerance index
- Bioaccumulation factor
- Translocation factor
- Remediation index

## Installation

```r
devtools::install_github(
  "tariq6640/MetalBiomeR"
)
```

## Example

```r
corr <- metal_correlate(
  otu,
  metal
)

metal_heatmap(corr)

g <- metal_network(corr)

keystone_taxa(g)
```
